description:
Parse and resolve each issue-id path parameter once in the server routes, before any executor call.

## Background

Server routes take ids as `Path<String>` (`crates/server/src/routes.rs:97,597,627,791,836,893,910`) and pass them to executor methods that resolve them internally.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each issue-id path parameter is parsed once into `IssueIdPrefix` and resolved once to `IssueId` before the executor call.
- [hard] REQ-02: A too-short prefix yields the route's invalid-prefix response, and an unknown or other malformed id yields its existing not-found response.
- [hard] REQ-03: No other server code parses an issue-id parameter, and the routes hold no interim call-site parse.
title: The server resolves each issue-id path parameter once
